payload.rationale: Journey stage is 'planning' (brief). services.md has no 'planning' rule; the brief's goal is a Wedded Concierge enquiry, so /wonderland-concierge is primary with /magazine as the lower-commitment magnet, matching the placed links. CTA anchors are 'Wedded Concierge' as placed (2 words, no 'click here', no exclamation marks). services.md's default wording 'Speak with a Wedded Advisor' is not substituted because the orchestrator fixed the anchors. Panel use: every persona that would click ('maybe': planner_couple, funding_parent, sceptic) named 'fee agreed in writing before any work begins' as the reason. That claim now sits in the sentence before the primary link (panel must_fix advisor_mid, applied in 08-final.md) and in the closing line, so the thing readers wanted to see comes before both main CTAs. No copy change is needed for that. Secondary CTA review (panel 'consider', sceptic found it a redundant pitch; uhnw and search_visitor would not click). Recommendation only, not applied, 08-final.md unchanged: tie the line to the template the reader has just filled in and give it the one brand-facts claim it lacks, keeping the anchor and link exactly. Suggested wording: 'Once the template is filled in, the venue questions behind it can go to one person: a Wedded Advisor who works in your time zone, through [Wedded Concierge](/wonderland-concierge?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=wedding-timeline-4pm-ceremony&utm_content=secondary).' The magnet sentence that follows stays as is. Claims used: one Wedded Advisor as a single point of contact; works in the couple's time zone (brand-facts 'Claims we can make'). Nothing about fees detail, on-the-day roles, transfers, room blocks, Privileges or availability. If the writer prefers not to touch it, the current line is compliant and can ship. Lead magnet: /magazine exists and is placed. The ideal magnet for this post would be a printable or downloadable 4pm run sheet (search_visitor asked for it; panel deferred it to CRO). It does not exist on the site, so it is a suggestion for the content team only: not placed, no link, no UTM proposed. No new UTM links, prices, fee detail, commissions, deposits, phone or named contacts, on-the-ground roles, transfers, room blocks, Privileges or availability are proposed. Readers' unanswered questions that the Concierge page should answer are listed in open_questions for /wonderland-concierge.

Can a couple or parent speak to someone by phone before booking, who is that person, and who do they ring close to the day given the time difference? (funding_parent)
What does 'single point of contact from start to finish' include, and who is accountable if something goes wrong on the day itself? (planner_couple)
Does the Advisor work with vendors they already know at the destination? (planner_couple)
Does the service help with travel insurance or guests with medical needs abroad? (funding_parent)
Can the page show (privately) experience with 200 to 400 guest weddings, and is there a private or referral route to an Advisor rather than the general form? (uhnw)
Where can readers see a real wedding (with consent) and independent reviews of Wedded Concierge? (sceptic, planner_couple)
